support_claim: Identity-establishing evidence links billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH to registry:HRB 88421 via an unchanged register number across rebrand and a registry row naming Oakfield Logistik GmbH for HRB 88421.

propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and the Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
propositions.relevance: Links the billing referent name Oakfield Logistik GmbH to registry identifier HRB 88421 by stating the register number was unchanged across the rebrand to the current legal name.

propositions.proposition: CRM still shows the old English-facing name Oakfield Logistics GmbH despite the 2023 rebrand to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Documents a legacy name variant in CRM; contextual to name usage but does not by itself tie billing name to the registry number.

propositions.proposition: Registry row HRB 88421 lists the registered legal name as Oakfield Logistik GmbH in Germany with active status.
propositions.relevance: Directly associates the right referent (registry:HRB 88421) with the legal name Oakfield Logistik GmbH, matching the left referent.

propositions.proposition: Billing records bill under the name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Confirms the left referent (billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH) appears as the billed counterparty name in billing sources.
